page.title: How referrals work
page.description: Refer estate agents to PropertyList and earn credits when they join and become active. Both agents benefit with rewards redeemable on all paid features.
page.body:
How to Use the PropertyList Referral Program — Copy-and-Paste Ready Page

Simple, transparent, rewarding. Earn 20 Credits (€20) for every agency that joins via your referral - and they get 20 Credits too. Use your unique link to share fast and professionally.


  1. 🚀 Step 1: Copy your unique referral link
    Inside your dashboard, you’ll find your personal referral link. Click your Name, in the dropdown click "Refferals".
    👉 or click here
  2. 💬 Step 2: Share it with agents you trust
    For best results, send a short personal message explaining why you think PropertyList will benefit them - Free to join!
    (WhatsApp, email, LinkedIn, social).
  3. ✅ Step 3: Approval & tracking
    Once the referred agent registers, our admin team reviews and approves their account.
    You can track all your referrals in your referrals dashboard. 
  4. 🎁 Step 4: Get rewarded (win-win)
    When your referred agent is approved:
    You receive 20 credits (worth €20)
    &
    They receive 20 credits     (worth €20)
    Both of you can use these credits toward featuring listings, ai tools, and all paid platform features.

Grow your network. Help other agents succeed. Get rewarded for it.


This link is unique to you and automatically tracks every agent who signs up through it - so you always get full credit for your referrals.


What happens after someone signs up with your link

  • The referred agent completes registration using your unique link.
  • Our admin team reviews and approves the account (this ensures quality and prevents abuse).
  • Once approved, you see the referral in your Referral Dashboard and 20 Credits are added to both accounts.
  • Everything is tracked automatically — no manual reporting required.

Where to find your referrals & credits

  • Click your Name, then in the dropdown click "Refferals", here you can to see pending and approved sign-ups, dates, and status.

Common questions (short FAQ)


Q: How long until credits appear?
A: Credits are added to both accounts immediately after the referred agent’s account is approved.

Q: What does “approved” mean?
A: Approval means our admin has validated the agent’s registration (identity/business checks) to keep the platform professional.

Q: How many agencies can I refer?
A: The program is designed for ongoing referrals. Zero limits or caps.

Q: Where do credits show up?
A: Dashboard → Credits (and in the Referral Dashboard for visibility).

Q: What if the referred agent isn’t approved?
A: If approval is not granted, no credits are issued. Encourage correct registration details and resubmission, if necessary; contact support for help.
